senses.gloss:
I. 6 Ā. (द्रियते, दृत; desid. दिदरिषते) (rarely used by itself, usually found in combination with आ) 
__1 To respect, honour, worship, reverence; द्वितीयाद्रियते सदा [[H. Pr. 7]]; [[Mv. 7. 3]]; [[Bk. 6. 55.]] 
__2 To care for, mind; usually with न. 
__3 To apply or devote oneself closely to, have regard for; भूरि श्रुतं शाश्वतमाद्रियन्ते [[Māl. 1. 5.]] 
__4 To desire. --II. 5 P. (दृणोति) To hurt, kill. --III. 10 P. (दारयति, दरयति) to fear; [[L. D. B.]]

I. 4, 9 P. (दीर्यति, दॄणाति, दीर्ण) 
__1 To burst or break asunder, split open. 
__2 To cause to burst, tear, divide, rend, sunder, pull to pieces. -Pass. (दीर्यते) 
__1 To burst, break open, be sundered; कथमेवं प्रलपतां वः सहस्रधा न दीर्णमनया जिह्वया [[Ve. 3.]] 
__2 To separate. 
__3 To be afraid, to fear. -Caus. (द-दा-रयति-ते) 
__1 To split, tear asunder, divide by digging. 
__2 To disperse, scatter. --II 1 P. (दरति) To fear, be afraid of. (With prepositions like अव, आ, प्र, &c. the root does not change its meaning.)
